clue.text: Combination lock in a case that is left undone

indicators.note: in tells us the scrambled letters go inside the word for a case

parts.note: a bag is a case for carrying things

indicators.note: a combination is a mixing together, so the letters of lock are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: A combination lock on a briefcase has been left open.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Combination' looks like the type of lock, but it is the anagram signal; 'in' then sets the rearranged letters inside the case.
explanation.definitionFit: A backlog is the pile of work still waiting to be done.

clue.text: Denigrate poverty in a Scottish highland

indicators.note: in says the word for poverty goes inside the Scottish mountain

parts.note: ben is a Scottish word for a mountain, as in Ben Nevis
lack means want or poverty

explanation.surface: Insulting the poverty of a Highland region.
explanation.definitionFit: To defame someone's reputation is to sully it.

clue.text: Electricity is in the news

parts.note: an electric flow is a current, and dealings in the news make it topical events

explanation.surface: Power supply is making headlines.
explanation.walkthrough: Electricity is current; things in the news are topical matters.
explanation.definitionFit: Topical events reported in the media.

clue.text: Euro-commissioner who could turn up for Christmas

indicators.note: in a down answer turn up means the letters are read upwards, in reverse

parts.note: Noel is another word for Christmas

explanation.surface: A Brussels official who might show up at Christmas.
explanation.walkthrough: Leon Brittan was a British European Commissioner in the 1990s.
explanation.definitionFit: Leon Brittan served as a Commissioner of the European Union.

clue.text: The death of monotheism proves a boon

parts.note: monotheism is belief in one God, so of monotheism gives the possessive God's
end means death

explanation.surface: The decline of belief in one deity turns out to be a blessing.
explanation.definitionFit: A welcome, timely blessing.

clue.text: Disregard a college servant

definitions.meaning: to pass over or omit something
at Trinity College Dublin a manservant is traditionally called a ...

explanation.walkthrough: The college-servant sense is the Trinity College Dublin name, akin to the Oxford scout and Cambridge gyp.
explanation.definitionFit: To skip a chapter is to pass over it, and a skip is a Dublin college attendant.

clue.text: Redrafting an act is diabolical

indicators.note: redrafting rewrites text, so these letters are put in a new order

explanation.surface: Rewriting a parliamentary act is fiendishly bad.
explanation.definitionFit: Of the Devil, fiendish.

clue.text: I take Mr Reagan to the club

parts.note: Ronald Reagan, the US president, was known as Ron

explanation.surface: Someone takes President Reagan to the nightclub.
explanation.definitionFit: A golf club with an angled metal head.

clue.text: The Parisian husband needs space

parts.note: le is French for the
a groom is a newly married husband

explanation.surface: A Frenchman's husband wants some room.
explanation.definitionFit: Room to stretch out the legs, as in a car or plane seat.

clue.text: To be evasive resort to making anagrams

definitions.meaning: chopping up words, as an anagram does

explanation.definitionFit: Idiomatically to soften what you say; literally cutting words into little pieces, as an anagrammer does.

clue.text: Making known views which contain a proviso for cooling off

indicators.note: which contain says the first piece holds the second inside it

parts.note: airing your views is making them known
a condition is a proviso or stipulation

explanation.surface: Voicing opinions with strings attached as a way of letting tempers cool.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Making known views' is a single idea, voicing opinions; 'which contain' then puts the proviso inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Such a system chills the air indoors, lowering room temperature.

clue.text: Continue to look furtively back

indicators.note: back says the word for a furtive look is written in reverse order

parts.note: to peek is to take a sly glance

explanation.surface: Someone keeps glancing back over a shoulder.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep going is to carry on, as in keep walking.

clue.text: Has plans to make money

definitions.meaning: intends, as in she ... to go

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is intends; the other is wealth, as in living beyond your resources.

clue.text: Some mundane chores are repetitive

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Boring household jobs are the same every day.
explanation.definitionFit: To resound again is to repeat, as sounds bouncing off walls do.

clue.text: Certainly not a light colour

definitions.meaning: shadow is the opposite of illumination
a tone or hue, as in a pale tint of blue

explanation.definitionFit: Shadow is darkness, not illumination; also a hue or tint.

clue.text: Taking a horse into Sunday School causes problems

indicators.note: taking into puts the horse inside the school's letters

parts.note: SS abbreviates Sunday School
a nag is an old horse

explanation.surface: Bringing a horse into Sunday School makes trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: Hitches or difficulties that hold things up.

clue.text: Well-known, distinguished citizen inside. Got nicked?

indicators.note: inside says the honour's letters sit within the word for famous

parts.note: noted means famous or well-known
CH stands for Companion of Honour, a British honour given to distinguished people

explanation.surface: A famous worthy is behind bars: did they get arrested?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nicked' is British slang for arrested, which the surface plays on; the definition means cut with a small nick.
explanation.definitionFit: Something nicked has had small cuts made in its edge.

clue.text: Study racing records and follow the rules

parts.note: to con is an old word meaning to study or learn
form is a horse's record of past race results

explanation.surface: A punter studies the form guide while staying within the rules.
explanation.definitionFit: To comply is to obey regulations and do what is expected.

clue.text: He had no faith in Batista's opponent

parts.note: Fidel Castro overthrew the Cuban dictator Fulgencio Batista in 1959

explanation.surface: Someone lacked belief in the revolutionary who fought Batista.
explanation.definitionFit: An unbeliever is someone without religious belief.

clue.text: To that extent the team is still batting

parts.note: in cricket the side batting is said to be in
so far means up to now, still

explanation.surface: The cricket side has not been dismissed yet.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the team batting is in.
explanation.definitionFit: A phrase meaning to the degree that.

clue.text: Striker carrying comparatively little weight

definitions.meaning: a device struck to make a flame

explanation.definitionFit: A cigarette device produces a flame; also less heavy than another.

clue.text: Man appearing in important commercial is full of himself

indicators.note: appearing in puts the word for a man inside the other pieces

parts.note: big means important
an ad is a commercial
he is a pronoun for a man

explanation.surface: An actor starring in a major advert has become conceited.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' looks like the subject of the sentence, but it is just the pronoun placed inside the important commercial.
explanation.definitionFit: A conceited person who thinks too highly of themselves is called this.

clue.text: The fish that makes one fat?

definitions.meaning: something that swells or puffs you up

explanation.definitionFit: A cured herring; also whimsically something that bloats you.

clue.text: Daughter was irritated when jilted

parts.note: itched means felt irritation

explanation.surface: A daughter was annoyed when her lover left her.
explanation.definitionFit: Dumped by a partner, abandoned.

clue.text: Pretend that it's quiet in the morning

parts.note: sh is the call for silence
AM, ante meridiem, means before noon

explanation.surface: Someone fakes calm in the early hours.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to fake or feign.

clue.text: Shimmering silver in short supply

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
low means running short, as in stocks are low

explanation.surface: Gleaming silver is scarce.
explanation.definitionFit: Glowing with light, so bright and shining.

clue.text: Bring back the strap and use it

indicators.note: Bring back says the word for a strap is written backwards

parts.note: a taws is a leather strap once used for punishment in Scottish schools

explanation.surface: A call to restore corporal punishment and apply the strap.
explanation.walkthrough: TAWS (or tawse) is a Scottish school strap; reversed it gives the answer, and use it means hit with it.
explanation.definitionFit: To strike sharply, which is what you do with a strap.

clue.text: The cheek of the guy

definitions.meaning: a jaw or side of the face, chop

explanation.definitionFit: Chap is an old word for jaw or cheek, and informally a man.

clue.text: Enemy captives given back in exchange

indicators.note: given back says the letters for prisoners of war run in reverse

parts.note: POWs are prisoners of war

explanation.surface: Prisoners of war are returned in a trade.
explanation.definitionFit: A variant spelling of swap, meaning a trade.

clue.text: At a fair price, if it's any use to you

definitions.meaning: at its true value, paying no more than deserved

definitions.text: if it's any use to you
definitions.meaning: a phrase offering a remark that may or may not help

explanation.definitionFit: Literally at its proper value; idiomatically a modest offering of advice.

clue.text: Hits back in the boxing-match

indicators.note: back says the word for hits is to be written in reverse

parts.note: raps are sharp blows

explanation.surface: A fighter hits back in a bout.
explanation.definitionFit: A practice bout between boxers is a sparring session.

clue.text: Sat again and rested

parts.note: re- is a prefix meaning again
to sit for a portrait is to pose

explanation.surface: A model sat for the painter again, then took a break.
explanation.definitionFit: Lay at ease, relaxed.
